'''Jedi command''' was the branch of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that oversaw communications received through the Council spire's topmasts and the Order's military conduct of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was centralized on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. All transmissions to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Command came through the [[Situation Room/Legends|War Room]] where it went through a pyramidal hierarchy to distribute information through the Temple's [[Holomap Room]]s. Twelve teams monitored in detail very specific locations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Potential problems were then transferred to a different team to be scrutinized even closer. If the disturbance was in fact dangerous, this information would once again be transferred to the datascreens of senior Jedi, who would transfer all data to be plotted on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] holomap within the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]].

The [[Security Act amendment]] stripped much of its authority and gave it to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]; the entire command system would later be eradicated with the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].
